## Où j'en suis
The real replay for 2026-11-12 is done: job `replay-1` ran for 47m and produced all 18,442,107 events into `events.replay.v3`, with 3,118 schema-v2 lines parked in the rejects file on S3; PR #233 was approved and merged by Daniel the night before. The aggregator backfill `backfill-2026-11-12` is running against that topic and was at 61% (hours 15–23 in progress), with ClickHouse `events_v3` at 14.9M rows in the incident window versus ~20.5M expected for the same weekday last week — so the counts do not match yet and the incident is still open (source: ses-rp-2, r2-04, r2-06)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 in progress (61% at last check, hours 15–23 remaining) (source: ses-rp-2, r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to hit 100%, then compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour against last week at 1% tolerance, and only then close the incident (source: r2-08, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled (exit 137, 2Gi limit, namespace quota capped by Noa); 5k batches run at 310 MiB peak (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [question] Rachel owes Fernhill and Orbitly an exact restoration date — Orbitly expects today, Wed Nov 18, and is holding it for a board report (source: src-zendesk-orbitly, r2-07)
- [décision] Replay everything, nothing dropped, into `events.replay.v3` and never into `events.v3` directly from the tool (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] The dedup-key CI check is Daniel's; no other fix goes in for this incident, so the fork PR #241 is ignored (source: src-slack-incident, r2-09, src-pr241-fork)
